example_sentences_in_bangla: বয়স তো অনেক হল, চৈতন্যোদয় হবে কবে?
তার জীবনে চৈতন্যোদয় ঘটেছে, এখন সবকিছু বুঝতে পারে।
example_sentences_in_english: He's advanced in years, but when will his intellect develop?
His life has seen the dawn of awareness; now he understands everything.
history: References Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, the 15th-16th century Bengali saint and founder of Gaudiya Vaishnavism, symbolizing spiritual awakening.
note: The idiom draws from the name 'Chaitanya' (meaning consciousness), often alluding to the historical figure's life and teachings in Bengali culture.
